annotations.title: Roll back to an earlier version

description: Redeploy an earlier version of the project, named by its state_version from list_versions. Two things surprise people and you must not report either one wrongly. First, the version number does NOT go back: this creates a NEW version holding the old one's contents, numbered higher than every existing one, so after rolling back to 3 the project is on 12, not 3. Second, it restores the specification and NOT the secrets — the current secret values are re-pinned into the new version, and a password that was rotated or removed does not come back. If the stored version no longer passes validation the call is refused rather than deploying something similar; the reason says what is wrong with it.
name: rollback
title: Roll back to an earlier version
